authentication: same-origin session and x-carr-csrf; no caller authority fields
invariants: Create seeds empty draft version 1; later versions require an accepted base.
Stops and transitions append; saving freezes the browser draft for review.
Held and excluded stops send null sequence and label; property_id never comes from route_label.
Every new stop and every prior stop has a transition before explicit acceptance.
Fixed accepted appointments retain their window, dwell and buffer.
409 is a refusal; network, 5xx and failed post-write reads are unknown outcomes.
Unknown outcomes require a successful read before explicit same-key retry; no automatic writes.
Pending intents are tab-local and bound to a hash of the current session CSRF token.
Acceptance compares the reviewed server digest with current draft contents; changed contents require reload and a new review.

The current detail read omits endpoints, transition rows and assertion-set digests; endpoints for a new version require manual entry, changes are compared with accepted stops, and a missing digest binds the visible candidate snapshot without upgrading unknown access or rights.

reviewed_route.missing_digest: withhold review and acceptance; reload after the producer is updated
reviewed_route.invariant: Forward the opaque server digest from the same detail as the displayed stop set; never refresh the digest when accepting.
